hangi-dosyalar.a: STL and 3MF are the main production formats. OBJ, STEP and STP are also accepted for quotes. Picking a file is not automatic production approval.

model-yok.q: What if I don’t have a model?
model-yok.a: Describe the idea, search ready models, pick from the library, or contact us with size and references.

fiyat.a: Ready products use the card price. Uploaded models show a price after production analysis and the signed formula.

toplu-uretim.a: Samples and repeat jobs go through the corporate quote form. Capacity is not claimed before the file or brief is reviewed.
